title: Letter grades
description: letter_grade(score) turns a whole-number score into a grade: 'A' for 70 and above, 'B' for 60 to 69, 'C' for 50 to 59 and 'F' below 50.
expected_behaviour: letter_grade(70) returns 'A', letter_grade(65) returns 'B' and letter_grade(49) returns 'F'.

bug.summary: The comparisons use > instead of including the boundary, so 70, 60 and 50 get the grade below.

hints.1: Look closely at scores that sit exactly on a grade boundary. Which grade should a score of exactly 70 get?
hints.2: Compare the condition `score > 70` on line {line} with the description, which says that 70 and above earns an A.
hints.3: `>` is false when the score equals the boundary, so 70, 60 and 50 fall through to the next grade down. Each comparison needs to include the boundary value itself.
